Space.title: A Global Rebound for Mangroves
Space.sum: After decades of decline, this ecologically significant type of forest is making a comeback. A global rebound began around 2010, the scientists found, led by the expansion of mangrove forests in Asia, Australia, and South America. The researchers analyzed Landsat imagery collected between 1984 and 2023, looking for signs of changes in the extent and density of mangrove canopy.
